text:
Sam K: Compliance flagged FIN-EU requirement for 365d auth/session logs retention and wants a way to "playback" event sequences for audits. Thoughts on architecture?
Nora C: Storage+egress cost is the main issue. Also we must avoid giving auditors interactive prod access. Playback bundles sounds safer.
Vikram: Agreed. Idea: keep 90d in SIEM, mirror raw events to a CMK-encrypted forensic bucket with 370d lifecycle. Exports produce a signed, timebound "playback bundle" (sanitized JSONL + manifest).
Tori Sec: Security requirements: CMK protect raw store, 2-approver unwrap, immutable audit trail of unwrap ops, RBAC scoped auditor role, network-isolated sandbox for playback, PII redaction gates.
ops-bot: Ticket created: SEC-5012 - forensic-playback-and-jit-unlock (https://tickets.internal/SEC-5012)
Sam K: Can we enforce redact-by-default and require explicit legal approval for any raw PII in bundles?
Vikram: Yes. Default scrub policy is mask-all-PII. Approval service can flip scrub flag for Legal+Sec sign-off. Unwrap flow via kms-proxy issues short-lived unwrap tokens and signed URLs.
Nora C: Implementation notes: manifest must include requestor, approvers, justification, CMK id, bundle hash, scrub_policy, created_at. All unwraps logged to WORM audit sink.
Tori Sec: Approver policy: 2-of-3 from [SecLead, ComplianceLead, Legal]. For internal triage (vuln investigations) we allow 1 SecLead + Oncall, TTL=4h. For external auditors TTL=12h and require Legal.
Vikram: Config example (conceptual):
```
unwrap_policy: 
  approvers_required: 2
  ttl_hours: 12
  allowed_tags: ["forensic_playback","external_audit"]
  scrub_policy: "mask_by_default"
```
Sam K: Sandbox: ephemeral VPC, ingest only sanitized bundle, auditor accounts are short-lived, MFA-only, and egress restricted to auditor IPs. No direct SIEM queries.
Nora C: Cost ballpark: storage + packaging + sandbox runtimes ~ $1.9k/mo per active external audit. Need finance approval for recurring audits.
Tori Sec: Tokenization keys must rotate independently of CMKs. Token service should refuse raw outputs unless unwrap flow used. Also require bundle hashes recorded for integrity checks.
Vikram: For vuln triage reuse: tag 'triage' with 4h TTL, stricter justification, and require immediate notification to oncall Slack channel during unwrap. Log includes requestor, approvers, justification, bundle_hash, unwrap_ts.
ops-bot: SEC-5012 linked to #ops and will emit events on bundle creation and unwraps.
Sam K: Action items:
- VIKRAM: design kms-proxy changes, manifest schema, and unwrap API (48h)
- TORI: write RBAC matrix, approver matrix, and scrub policy (72h)
- NORA: cost estimate + sandbox playbook + procurement touchpoint (48h)
- SAM: open RFC draft and coordinate Legal + Compliance signoff (ASAP)
Tori Sec: Quick question: do we allow partner auditors to request ad-hoc fields in a bundle? Prefer no. They must request via RFC and Legal review.
Sam K: Agreed. Controlled bundles only. No ad-hoc interactive queries.
Vikram: One more engineering caveat: ensure the tokenization service uses separate KMS keys and that rotation doesn't invalidate historic manifests; include key version in manifest.
Nora C: ACK. Also add a human review step if scrub_policy would materially alter event semantics.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: update SEC-5012 with designs in 48h.
Sam K: If no objections I'll start the RFC and tag Legal.
Tori Sec: No objections from Sec. I'll help with the wording.
Vikram: 👍
Sam K: Thanks everyone!
